# MDL904 · `required-key`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A key the conventions require is missing.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | conventions |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |

## Why

Required keys make every configuration state, for instance, where its dump goes. The rule does nothing unless the `conventions` section of the configuration sets it up.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
outputdir=/backups/sales
```

```text
1:2-1:10 error MDL904[required-key] [mydumper] must set logfile
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL904: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL904` on the line above it.
